expectation: Nuclear stain in intestinal epithelium: nearly all crypt and surface epithelial nuclei bright, in a continuous lining of glands; stroma, muscularis and lymphoid cells negative. Common wherever there is intestinal mucosa.
notes: Epithelial nuclei in the crypt (C) and in E stay blue, not yellow. The signal is cytoplasmic and stromal haze, brightest in the mucosa. The muscularis is lit with tile stripes, and the brightest spots are blobs outside nuclei, so this is not CDX2 nuclear staining.
observed: A: haze over the whole mucosa, the muscularis lit with tile stripes, bright dots. B: diffuse haze and blobs. C: crypt nuclei stay blue, yellow only in the cytoplasm and stroma. D: blobs not in nuclei. E1: mesh-like haze, nuclei dark.
why: CDX2 should be nuclear, but epithelial nuclei are unstained; the signal is cytoplasmic/autofluorescent haze, tile stripes and blobs.
